data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's proposed relation between complement-counting and the case-split is stated as a reduction, but the refutation condition is self-undermining: it claims the relation holds only if inclusion-exclusion terms align with the case-split boundary, then says it is refuted if they do NOT align. This makes the 'relation' conditional on an unstated alignment mechanism that is never exhibited — so the content asserts a compatibility/identity without providing the causal mechanism (the partition equality) that would substantiate it. Per the problem, a relation must be substantive; here the dependence is assumed, not demonstrated.
